product_one_liner.value: CoLab provides an AI-powered collaborative design-review platform that helps mechanical engineering and hardware development teams review CAD and drawings, capture engineering knowledge, and make faster design decisions.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes its audience as mechanical engineering and hardware development teams and its platform as a collaborative workspace for design decisions, reviews, and captured engineering knowledge. Sources: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260506737700/en/Poised-for-its-Next-Phase-of-Growth-CoLab-Adds-Design-and-Operational-Leadership ; https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/colabsoftware/jobs/5386531008

pricing_page.notes: The pricing URL serves homepage-style product and demo content rather than pricing plans, and the reviewed navigation contains no pricing link. Source: http://colabsoftware.com/pricing

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Both companies appear in CoLab's customer logo wall and accompanying customer testimonials. Source: https://www.colabsoftware.com/ | named_customers.0: Ford appears in a customer testimonial and the customer logo wall. Source: https://www.colabsoftware.com/ | named_customers.1: Schaeffler appears in a customer testimonial and the customer logo wall. Source: https://www.colabsoftware.com/

employee_band.notes: A current company job posting says CoLab has grown to a team of 250+, supporting the 201–500 band, although it does not provide an exact count or upper bound. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/colabsoftware/jobs/5386531008

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters profile names St. John's, corroborated by CoLab's own statement that it is based in St. John's, Newfoundland. Sources: https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/colab-software/employees ; https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/colabsoftware/jobs/5386531008 | hq_country: The company profile identifies its headquarters as St. John's, Canada. Source: https://www.reveliolabs.com/companies/colab-software/employees

founded_year.notes: CoLab explicitly states that it was founded in 2017. Source: https://www.colabsoftware.com/post/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed blog indexes contained one qualifying implementation post, CTO Jeremy Andrews's DFM article. The remaining reviewed entries concerned product usage, engineering management, or industry AI topics, so the required two engineer-authored implementation posts were not established. Sources: https://www.colabsoftware.com/blog ; https://www.colabsoftware.com/blog-categories/ai-in-engineering?84815041_page=2 ; https://www.colabsoftware.com/blog-categories/ai-in-engineering?84815041_page=3

public_docs.notes: The public Using CoLab help-center collection lists 39 articles, exceeding the several-articles requirement. Source: https://help.colabsoftware.com/en/collections/14517205-using-colab

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current Greenhouse posting is titled Senior 3D & AI Systems Software Developer, explicitly qualifying under the title rule. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/colabsoftware/jobs/5386531008

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Amazon Web Services
model_provider.notes: CoLab's subprocessor list explicitly identifies all five companies as LLM providers. These are provider disclosures, not claims that every provider is used for every customer request. Source: https://trust.colabsoftware.com/subprocessors

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The trust center names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001:2022. Other ISO standards shown there are outside the requested five categories. Source: https://trust.colabsoftware.com/ | compliance_certs.0: The trust center explicitly names SOC 2 Type II. Source: https://trust.colabsoftware.com/ | compliance_certs.1: The trust center explicitly names ISO 27001:2022. Source: https://trust.colabsoftware.com/

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both the company announcement and latest-round profile identify the financing as Series C. Sources: https://www.colabsoftware.com/post/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation ; https://tracxn.com | funding_date: November 2025 is reported as the announcement month: CoLab dates its $72M Series C announcement November 10, while the funding profile establishes the round's year as 2025. There is a date discrepancy: the funding profile records October 9, 2025, which may represent a transaction date rather than the public announcement date. Sources: https://www.colabsoftware.com/post/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation ; https://tracxn.com | funding_amount_usd: The company announcement states $72 million USD, and the funding profile identifies the same Series C as its latest round. Sources: https://www.colabsoftware.com/post/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation ; https://tracxn.com

raised_18mo.notes: The $72M Series C occurred in 2025, within the requested 18-month window. Both the recorded October transaction date and November announcement month fall within that window, so the date discrepancy does not affect this boolean. Sources: https://tracxn.com ; https://www.colabsoftware.com/post/ai-is-changing-engineering-colab-just-raised-72m-to-lead-the-transformation

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live posting is for Key Account Executive – Aerospace & Defense and describes ownership of the full enterprise sales cycle. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/colabsoftware/jobs/5443535008

launched_6mo.notes: The September 30, 2026 announcement releases generative artifacts, including generation and refinement of DFMEAs and root-cause analyses. This falls within the six-month window; the separately planned 2027 generative CAD product is not counted. Source: https://www.colabsoftware.com/post/colab-generative-engineering-vision

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On May 6, 2026, CoLab announced Tom Greever joining as SVP of Design and Jessie Wheeler joining as SVP of Operations, within the requested 12-month window. Source: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260506737700/en/Poised-for-its-Next-Phase-of-Growth-CoLab-Adds-Design-and-Operational-Leadership
